migration.description: Add nullable exact upstream cache-write usage to live invocation rows and newly written archives, read older archives as unknown exact usage, and upgrade only unchanged temporary GPT-6 pricing seed rows.
migration.release_unit_description: Formal GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna pricing, usage accounting, API, and durable-state support.

durable_state.description: Nullable reported cache-write Token counts on invocation records, future invocation archives, and repo-managed pricing catalog version and seed rows. Existing invocation costs and historical exact cache-write counts are not rewritten.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite codex_invocations.reported_cache_write_tokens plus invocation archive datasets and the existing SQLite pricing catalog.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Supported 0.2.x database schemas before reported_cache_write_tokens and archives without the reported cache-write column, including the current candidate base 6417a434c6d6fb3277eac7df77581451bf0f12ad.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: Candidate release based on mainline commit 6417a434c6d6fb3277eac7df77581451bf0f12ad.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Within a SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, idempotently add nullable reported_cache_write_tokens to codex_invocations before new exact usage values are persisted; independent processes serialize schema inspection and DDL, and archive readers project NULL when reading legacy datasets without the column.

dml_changes.description: After schema recognition, upgrade only unchanged source=temporary GPT-6 Sol/Luna seed rows and add the Astra official seed under the new repo-managed price version; preserve edited rows, custom catalogs, Terra compatibility pricing, and all non-null historical costs.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: No historical exact cache-write count or non-null invocation cost backfill is performed. New usage writes use the nullable column; missing upstream exact usage remains NULL and uses the existing estimated allocation only for legacy semantics.

progress_signals: SQLite schema inspection confirms the nullable column exists before usage writes.
Repo-managed pricing version and seed rows are observable through the pricing settings API and catalog tests.
Invocation details distinguish a reported exact cache-write count from NULL legacy or missing-field records.
pause_points: After idempotent schema recognition and before guarded catalog seed upgrade.
No historical usage backfill runs; startup can stop after either completed additive step and safely re-enter.

recovery.program_rollback_state_behavior: Earlier readers may ignore the additive column; older writers cannot preserve the new field when re-archiving and therefore are not guaranteed same-Minor write-forward compatibility. No rollback removes the column or rewrites pricing rows.
recovery.faulty_release_recovery: A newer program version recognizes the nullable column, safely re-enters the guarded seed upgrade, and reads earlier archives with NULL exact cache-write usage; repair is forward-only.

required_test_evidence: The additive reported_cache_write_tokens field preserves existing public API behavior while exposing the new nullable value within the same Major.
Candidate reads supported earlier-Minor database state and legacy archives without fabricating exact cache-write counts.
Earlier-Minor programs are not required to preserve or read state written with the new column when re-archiving.
Idempotent schema migration and guarded pricing seeding safely re-enter after a stopped startup.
Stateful SQLite and archive-file-io test profiles cover prior schemas, legacy archives, exact-value round trips, and compatibility behavior.
